subject: Crop rotate
parts: a continuous L-shaped crop stroke descending from the upper left then turning right along the bottom, a second continuous inverted L-shaped crop stroke running from the left across the top then turning down at the right, these two strokes crossing at the top-left and bottom-right to enclose one square crop opening with four short projecting ends, and a separate clockwise curved arrow above and to the right with an open V-shaped arrowhead
